source: ترجمة آلية أعدّها Claude لنص: التفسير الميسّر (الجزء بعد علامة [التفسير])
translator: Claude (Anthropic) — غير مراجَعة من مترجم بشري
scopeNote: ترجمة للتفسير فقط؛ لا تُترجم الآيات القرآنية. الأصل العربي الحرفي هو المرجع.

tafsir.muyassar-1: Woe and ruin to every backbiter who slanders people.
tafsir.muyassar-2: He whose whole concern was gathering wealth and counting it.
tafsir.muyassar-3: He thinks that this wealth he has gathered has guaranteed him eternal life in this world and escape from reckoning.
tafsir.muyassar-4: It is not as he thought. He will surely be thrown into the fire that shatters everything cast into it.
tafsir.muyassar-5: And what could make you know, O Messenger, what the reality of this fire is?
tafsir.muyassar-6: It is the fire of God, kindled and fiercely blazing, whose heat is so intense that it penetrates from the bodies to the hearts.
tafsir.muyassar-7: It is the fire of God, kindled and fiercely blazing, whose heat is so intense that it penetrates from the bodies to the hearts.
tafsir.muyassar-8: It is closed over them, in long chains and shackles, so that they cannot come out of it.
tafsir.muyassar-9: It is closed over them, in long chains and shackles, so that they cannot come out of it.
